text: At its core, Cova is a Next.js web app on Vercel that orchestrates a set of Python GPU services deployed on Modal — those handle perception, furniture erasure, and the actual AI redesign — with Supabase as the shared database and auth layer tying it all together. The user flow goes from a style quiz that builds a taste fingerprint, to a room photo upload, to a multi-pass FLUX render driven by custom-trained style LoRAs, and finally to a shoppable product shelf matched via Google Shopping.
